Powerhouse chefs Antonia Lofaso and Ayesha Nurdjaja recruit competitors Pete Amadhanirundr and Evelyn Garcia for a fierce showdown against Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S25 E16 — The Nightmare Before Pastry
Katie Lee and Zac Young want to scare up a victory, but Bobby Flay isn't giving up without a fright; pastry chefs Michael McGowan and Kareem Queeman have a scream at the spooky star ingredient.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S12 E04 — Who's Ruining Your Ruin?
John Henson asks the bakers to create a dessert that resembles an assigned classic ruin and represent the monster who haunts it; judges Stephanie Boswell, Aarti Sequeira and Zac Young pick the winner to receive $1,000, and one baker goes home.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S12 E05 — Doll Trouble
Henson challenges the remaining six bakers to face off in head-to-head matchups to create demon doll desserts, either Paris-Brest, baked cheesecake, or Swiss roll; the winner of each matchup is safe, and the overall challenge winner receives $1,000.

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S01 E03 — Trick or Treat: Horror Story House
Host Josh Peck welcomes a team of ghost hunters into one of America's most famous haunted houses where baker Ashley Holt has hidden six secret sweets. If the trio of paranormal experts can divine them all, they'll win $12,000!

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S01 E04 — Trick or Treat: Movie Set Morgue
Host Josh Peck welcomes three horror movie buffs to a haunted hospital movie set to find six secret sweets hidden by master baker JonnyCakes among Hollywood props and behind-the-scenes movie gear. Can they dissect the truth and win $12,000?

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E05 — Back from the Dead: Nightmare Pet Shop
Monstrous pets take over as Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create haunted pet shop showpieces and pumpkin-infused desserts; a surprise carving battle puts the teams to the test before judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller make their decision.

description:
S01 E04 — Holiday Feast
Host Wells Adams asks the empires to create hyperrealistic cakes that look like a holiday feast but taste like a decadent dessert; the teams that deliver both illusion and flavor for the judges continue their empire's reign.

title: Wounded Warrior Project: No Warrior is Left Behind
description: Wounded Warrior Project is changing the way our nation cares for veterans and helping them thrive for a lifetime. Join Trace Adkins and Dan Nevins to learn about the journeys of four injured veterans and how no warrior is left behind.

title: Looking for a Medicare plan? Tune in now!
description: The Medicare annual election period ends on December 7th. Watch and learn about Humana Medicare Advantage plans.
